counts.note: Counts are relative only to the inspected 52-open library build; no earlier-push reductions are added because that build may already incorporate them.

new_proved_obligations.statement: For commuting iterates f^N and f^r, local degrees satisfy e_r(z)e_N(f^r z)=e_N(z)e_r(f^N z). For a quadratic polynomial, the branch/cylinder factorizations are two cuts of the same complete chronological critical word.

Every proper commuting square satisfies deg(H)deg(h_1)=deg(h_0)deg(F), with the corresponding pointwise local-degree identity. With a univalent source projection and quadratic root branch, the quadratic degree lies either in the lifted branch or in the target projection.

A univalent root polynomial branch lifted through a univalent polynomial cylinder is automatically univalent; its actual image is a forced target base on which the equal-depth projection is univalent. Prime-end phase, protected chains, and cyclic order transport by the commuting conformal square.

Given an actual root branch F=f^r:A->B with A compactly contained in B compactly contained in the direct-decoration root puzzle P, every finite univalent cylinder h_w=f^{N_w}:Q_w->P carries the actual covering/embedded pair (f^{N_w+r},f^{N_w}):h_w^{-1}(A) => B. The covering has the same degree as F; the common univalent prefix cancels from the relative critical word; root markings, obstacles, phase, and cyclic order pull back exactly; and the family is shift- and enlargement-natural.

For f(z)=z^2-1, a proper commuting lift can move the root quadratic degree into the target projection. A second explicit lift has univalent source and target projections and equal total return degree two but changes the chronological word from (2,1) to (1,2).

For each intermediate one-step square, lifted_degree_j*projection_degree_{j+1}=projection_degree_j*root_degree_j. With univalent initial projection, exact chronological degree-word transfer is equivalent to univalence of every transverse projection, not merely the endpoint projection or equality of total degree.

For a proper degree-two map of Jordan disks and an embedded Jordan subdisk with boundary avoiding the critical value, the pullback is one connected degree-two Jordan disk exactly when the subdisk contains the critical value; if it omits the critical value, the pullback is two conformal components.

A finite cyclic covering/embedded stage system with exactly one quadratic stage, boundary critical-value avoidance, compatible relative-cover components, and post-quadratic critical-value retention has a unique connected full-degree fiber-product component and a degree-two endpoint covering. The first omitted critical value is the exact degree-loss certificate.

Actual compatible marked stages satisfying the critical-spine hypotheses assemble into a closed degree-two endpoint correspondence. If each relative stage g_j o iota_j^{-1} is an actual restriction f^{s_j}, then the endpoint relative map G_m o I_m^{-1} is f^{sum s_j}; the chronological word, component routes, relative-cover lifts, prime-end action, proper/end-proper flags, and enlargement squares compose exactly.

A fixed actual iterate with parent-compatible finite-cylinder target components extends by nested intersection to the corresponding end fibers. This theorem does not apply directly to retimed finite-word pairs whose covering exponents grow with word length.

A connected quadratic-like map can be restricted inside any prescribed Jordan neighborhood compactly containing its filled Julia set, preserving degree, filled Julia set, polynomial iterate, and chronological critical word.

After localizing an actual root quadratic-like portrait inside the direct-decoration gap, every finite univalent cylinder carries the exact pseudo-quadratic-like pair (f^{N_w+r},f^{N_w}) with pulled filled carrier, relative critical word, finite protected marking, obstacle ledger, and shift/enlargement naturality.

In the source ray/equipotential puzzle geometry, every infinite direct-decoration address determines one external prime-end angle, its nested end fiber is the corresponding impression, and angle/impression dynamics commute with the pre-root shift.

Along every infinite direct-decoration address, the inverse branches converge only to constant maps on compact subsets of the root puzzle interior; images of every compact interior carrier have diameter tending to zero. Hence a nondegenerate end portrait cannot be obtained as an unrescaled planar normal-family limit.

In the cylinder coordinate, every retimed finite-word pseudo-quadratic-like pair is identically the root pair. The internal analytic germ is constant and nondegenerate; the remaining end work is construction of a prime-end blow-up or rescaled marked fiber carrying it.

Any Hausdorff end realization retaining a nondegenerate normalized carrier and admitting a continuous projection to the original dynamical plane must place the limiting carrier in a nontrivial projection fiber. Hence a source-faithful end realization requires a rescaling or prime-end blow-up unless an independent planar component theorem is supplied.

status_changes.replacement_statement: Every finite family of compatible proper, core-proper, covering-embedded marked stages with one quadratic stage assembles through the critical-spine telescope into a closed selected degree-two endpoint correspondence retaining all stated stagewise depth-q admissibility data.
status_changes.note: This is a compiler theorem. Constructing actual virtual stages remains in H1_FINITE_HORIZON_INFLATION and the virtual marked-correspondence nodes.

corrected_statement_promotion.old_statement_problem: Degree-two factorization alone does not ensure that a connected base-change component retains degree two; a subdisk avoiding the critical value splits the pullback into two degree-one components.
corrected_statement_promotion.replacement_statement: A finite cyclic covering/embedded stage system with exactly one quadratic stage, boundary critical-value avoidance, compatible relative-cover component selection, and post-quadratic critical-spine retention has a unique connected selected fiber-product component whose routing closes and whose endpoint covering has degree two.

open_node_refinement.residual_statement: For each required infinite address, construct an analytic prime-end blow-up or rescaled marked surface with a nondegenerate carrier and continuous collapse map to the canonical prime-end impression, realize the constant normalized root pseudo-quadratic-like germ and all protected data on that fiber, and construct every demanded multi-stage chain with post-quadratic critical-spine retention and full relative-cover orbit.

dependency_corrections.note: Do not infer critical chronology from total degree, endpoint target univalence, or a commuting f^N/f^r square. Depend on STAGEWISE_CRITICAL_WORD_LADDER for the central branch.

scope_notes: FINITE_CYLINDER_SECOND_PORTRAIT_TRANSFER is a finite-word result and assumes the actual root renormalization/portrait has been named; LOCALIZED_QL_RESTRICTION places it in the direct-decoration gap.
DIRECT_DECORATION_END_PRIME_END_CODING uses the source ray/equipotential puzzle structure; it does not identify the end impression as a small Julia set.
END_FIBER_ACTION_EXTENSION applies only to one fixed iterate. Retimed finite-word coverings have exponents N_w+r and are represented at ends by the normalized germ, not by that fixed-iterate theorem.

PLANAR_END_COLLAPSE_NO_GO and END_BLOWUP_NECESSITY show that a nondegenerate end portrait cannot remain locally embedded in the original plane; the correct residual category is a rescaled or prime-end blow-up marked fiber unless a separate planar component theorem is supplied.
